scripts.api:types: cd apps/api && uv run python -m scripts.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @qrmenu/api-client generate
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8010
scripts.api:lint: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy app
scripts.api:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
